entities.name: PMID:22362607
observations: Adult Chinese cochlear implant users: lexical-tone identification significantly correlated with pitch-discrimination, melody-discrimination, and instrument-identification performance; abstract-level report lacked coefficients and p-values.

entities.name: PMID:33660560
observations: In 16 Mandarin-speaking bimodal CI users, benefit for tone recognition in noise correlated with bimodal benefit in pitch-discrimination thresholds and instrument identification; no melody-discrimination correlation was reported.

entities.name: CI pitch-tone association
observations: A study of adult Chinese CI users reported significant associations between lexical-tone identification and both pitch and melody discrimination; effect sizes were not available in the retrieved abstract.

entities.name: Bimodal tone-music benefit
observations: In Mandarin-speaking bimodal CI users, tone-recognition benefit in noise correlated with pitch-discrimination and instrument-identification benefits; melody benefit correlation was not reported.
